title: Can I BEAT Cross Derby? (NEW Variant)
summary: The creator tries Cross Derby, a then-new chess.com variant, against human opponents (later up to ~2000). Each king is stuck in a corner, the armies are mostly knights that race to deliver checkmate, and pawns promote to knights. The board has squares outside the normal area (he can highlight 'squares out of the board'). Because blocking is nearly impossible with knights and the king is boxed in, the only real defence to a check is capturing the checking knight. He wins four games, including vs a 2000.
rules: Each king starts trapped in a corner (surrounded/limited squares).
Armies are mostly knights; pawns also present and promote only to knights.
Board includes squares outside the standard 8x8 area (cross-shaped/extended board; exact shape not established from transcript).
Normal checkmate wins; with knights checks can't be blocked, so a check must be answered by capturing the checker or moving the king.
win_condition: Checkmate the cornered king. Goal: win 3 games.

board.shape_notes: Non-standard: extra squares outside the normal board ('squares out of the board'); kings in corners. Exact geometry UNKNOWN - needs frame or chess.com check.
